basic_info.description: Traditional Westlake split-level home offers over 1,900 sq ft of smart and gracious living space! The main living area flows from the charming living room with wood-burning fireplace and corner windows to the open dining area and functional kitchen with granite breakfast bar and counter tops, custom cabinetry and a full suite of GE Monogram appliances. Outdoor entertaining  is made easy with a door leading to the expansive deck and lush yard. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms and a stylishly updated bathroom featuring 2 sinks and a shower over tub.  Downstairs is a spacious media room with retro wet bar and large closet or wine storage. A powder room,  laundry area and tons of storage finish the garage level.  Nearby Olympic Club, SF Golf Club, Lake Merced,  iconic Joe's of Westlake and Westlake Shopping Center & easy freeway access  to SF or the Peninsula make this home the perfect spot for urban dwellers and surburbanites alike!
